name: Retro Lamp Portable Camping Lantern-Black
description:
Specifications:
Color: Black(optional)
Material: ABS
Light color: warm light
Gear: stepless dimming
Power supply: built-in rechargeable lithium battery
Charging: about 2 hours
Usage: Can be used for about 5 hours
Brightness: 20~300 lumens
Waterproof grade: life-grade waterproof
Adapt to the scene: emergency, outdoor lighting, etc.
eatures:
1. Retro camping lights, exquisite workmanship, add classic elements to your tent.
2. Premium LED lamp beads, high brightness, 360° illumination, soft and not dazzling.
3. With 2 light modes, high light and low light, 1-key switching to meet different light needs.
4. USB Rechargeable (Include data cable)
5. Small and lightweight, with hook, easy to suspend, very suitable for camping, picnic, fishing, etc.
